target.name: Interaction_AdvanceResponseTarget
target.behavior: if current < pending, increment current by one; otherwise leave it unchanged

boundary_basis: The helper starts at 0x001B0434, saves D0, and ends with the restore plus RTS at 0x001B044A-0x001B044D.
Its two absolute-byte references match the response current/pending fields already written by player-collision handlers.
The next byte at 0x001B044E begins a distinct VDP digit-output routine.
